records.subject: Welcome aboard, Bright Media
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Adding the rest of your team
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Glad to hear Wrenfield is feeling good so far, and thanks for flagging that getting the rest of the team in is the next step. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for the whole group.

Happy to walk through it with you on a short call this week if you'd like a hand getting everyone added.

Best,
Chidi
